Dragons 1.2.8 - bug fixes and an optional "Left Shift flies down"

Fixes
- Venom Spit: the venom left on the ground no longer poisons the dragon's owner or the owner's animals, and no longer slows the dragon itself.
- Your dragon's abilities and attacks no longer hit your own horse (or any other animal you own).
- A saddled dragon that dies now drops its saddle.
- An egg without an owner (summoned with a command) now hatches a wild hatchling instead of a "tamed" one that nobody could use.

Riding
- New config option sneakFliesDown in config/skywyrms.json (default false, so nothing changes unless you turn it on). Set it to true and the sneak key (Left Shift) flies your dragon down while you are in the air and only dismounts on the ground or in water - no more falling off by accident. In multiplayer set it on the server and in your own game.

Reminder: the keys for "Fly Down" (X) and "Dragon Ability" (R) can be changed in Options > Controls > Key Binds > Skywyrms.

Thanks for the ideas and reports!
